gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
He finally succeeded in solving the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.lead: My grandfather had completely forgotten that he phoned me last night.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather didn't ___ phoning me last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Completely forgotten' becomes 'didn't have any recollection of'.

gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action continuing from a past point to now: has been working (present perfect continuous).
